questionText:
which word fills the blank in this research-library passage?

a flexible plan can reduce shame and make consistency easier.
food basics for women’s _____
healthy eating does not require perfect meals.
women need enough energy, protein, fiber, vitamins, minerals, and fluids.
nutrient needs vary by age, pregnancy, breastfeeding, activity, medical conditions, and menstrual bleeding.
iron matters because heavy periods can increase iron loss.
folate matters for people who could become pregnant.
calcium and vitamin D matter for bone health.
fiber supports digestion and fullness.
protein helps meals feel more satisfying.
fruits and vegetables provide vitamins, minerals, fiber, and fluid.
whole grains can support steadier energy.
